name: AI Agents and Search for the AEC Industry

mentions.name: AI Agents and Search for the AEC Industry
mentions.description: A startup building AI agents and search for the AEC (architecture, engineering, construction) industry, helping companies handle their paperwork using RAG, chat, agents, and deep research capabilities. The author recently joined as Head of Engineering.
mentions.problem: The AEC industry is weighed down by paperwork; the startup tries to improve it by handling that paperwork, with challenges including large data volumes and different stakeholders/user stories within one organization.
mentions.audience: Companies and professionals in the architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC) industry.
mentions.source_excerpt:
AI Agents and search for the AEC I industry.

Recently I was fortunate to join a cool startup (as Head of Engineering) that tries to improve the AEC industry by helping them with their paperwork.

So lots of RAG, chat, agents, deep research.
